KEYFACTSTOTPOP_CY.definition: Estimate of the total population in the geographic area. Total population indicates how many people typically live in an area in their private household at night.

HOUSEHOLDTOTALSTOTHH_CY.definition: Estimate of the total households in the geographic area. Private households are normally shown according to the 'housekeeping concept' (principal residence). They consist of one-person households (a person who lives alone in a separate housing unit) and multi-person households (a group of two or more persons who occupy the housing unit together and provide themselves with essentials for living).

HOUSEHOLDSBYINCOMEHINC01_CY.definition: Estimate of the households in the first (lowest) income quintile in the geographic area. On the national level the number of households is distributed into 5 classes according to their disposable household income with an equal number of households in each class. The first quintile represents the 20% households having the lowest income (on a national level), the fifth quintile represents the 20 % households with the highest income (on a national level) in each area.

HOUSEHOLDSBYINCOMEHINC02_CY.definition: Estimate of the households in the second income quintile in the geographic area. The first quintile represents the 20% households having the lowest income (on a national level), the fifth quintile represents the 20 % households with the highest income (on a national level) in each area.

The first quintile represents the 20% households having the lowest income (on a national level), the fifth (highest) quintile represents the 20 % households with the highest income (on a national level) in each area.

HOUSEHOLDTOTALSAVGHHSZ_CY.definition: Estimate of the average household size in the geographic area. The average household size is calculated by dividing the number of persons living in households by the total number of households in the geographic area.

EMPLOYMENTUNEMP_CY.definition: Estimate of the unemployed persons in the geographic area.

SPENDINGCS02_CY.definition: Estimate of alcoholic beverage expenditures in the geographic area. Consumer Spending data by categories monitor the expenditures of consumers for the various products and services. The target of these data evaluations is the expenditures for the products and services as such, no matter from which sector consumers acquire these products and services. This category includes alcoholic beverages purchased by households, regardless of where they are consumed. It excludes alcoholic drinks bought for immediate consumption in establishments such as restaurants, hotels, cafés, bars, kiosks, street vendors, or vending machines. Included in this category are also low- or non-alcoholic versions of beverages that are typically alcoholic, such as alcohol-free beer.

SPENDINGCS17_CY.definition: Estimate of books, newspapers, and stationery expenditures in the geographic area. Consumer Spending data by categories monitor the expenditures of consumers for the various products and services. The target of these data evaluations is the expenditures for the products and services as such, no matter from which sector consumers acquire these products and services. This category includes books in any form, musical scores, reproductions of educational books, novels, plays, poetry, etc. on any media, scrapbooks and albums, newspapers and magazines including electronic formats, posters, postcards, calendars, maps and globes, greeting cards, stationery, wrapping paper, pens, pencils, inks, erasers, pencil sharpeners, paper punches, paper cutters, paper scissors, office glues and adhesives, staplers, staples, paper clips and drawing and painting materials.

SPENDINGCS18_CY.definition: Estimate of catering services expenditures in the geographic area. Consumer Spending data by categories monitor the expenditures of consumers for the various products and services. The target of these data evaluations is the expenditures for the products and services as such, no matter from which sector consumers acquire these products and services. This category includes food and beverage services provided by restaurants, cafés and similar eating facilities providing full, limited or self-service, tobacco that is consumed with a shisha or a hookah pipe in restaurants, cafés or shisha lounges and tips and gratuities. It also includes food and beverages provided by restaurants, cafés, cafeterias and similar eating facilities at work/office premises, in schools, universities and other educational establishments. However, it excludes food and beverage provided by supermarkets and markets whether or not consumed on their premises, and food products and beverages dispensed by automatic vending machines.

SPENDINGCS04_CY.definition: Estimate of clothing expenditures in the geographic area. Consumer Spending data by categories monitor the expenditures of consumers for the various products and services. The target of these data evaluations is the expenditures for the products and services as such, no matter from which sector consumers acquire these products and services. This category includes garments for men and boys, women and girls and infants, either ready-to-wear or made to measure, in all materials (including leather, furs, plastics and rubber), for everyday wear, for sport or for work: capes, overcoats, raincoats, anoraks, parkas, blousons, jackets, trousers, waistcoats, suits, costumes, dresses, skirts, shirts, blouses, pullovers, sweaters, cardigans, shorts, swimsuits, tracksuits, jogging suits, sweatshirts, T-shirts, leotards, vests, underpants, socks, stockings, tights, petticoats, brassieres, knickers, slips, girdles, corsets, body stockings, pajamas, nightshirts, nightdresses, housecoats, dressing gowns, bathrobes, etc. traditional garments.  It also includes other articles of clothing and accessories such as: ties, handkerchiefs, scarves, gloves, mittens, muffs, belts, braces, aprons, smocks, bibs, sleeve protectors, hats, caps, berets, bonnets, sewing threads, knitting yarns and accessories used in the creation of clothing, such as buckles, buttons, press studs, zip fasteners, ribbons, laces, trimmings, etc.

SPENDINGCS13_CY.definition: Estimate of consumer electronics and IT/Communication equipment expenditures in the geographic area. Consumer Spending data by categories monitor the expenditures of consumers for the various products and services. The target of these data evaluations is the expenditures for the products and services as such, no matter from which sector consumers acquire these products and services. This category includes fixed telephones, answering machines, telephone loudspeakers, mobile telephone handsets, smartphones, personal computers, printers, photocopiers, scanners, monitors, projectors, augmented-reality and virtual-reality head mounts, modems, routers, network switches, keyboards, mice, tablets, calculators, toner and ink cartridges, typewriters, word processors, television sets, set-top boxes, video cassette players and recorders, digital video recorders (DVRs), DVD players, Blu-ray players, streaming boxes, radio receivers, portable and non-portable CD players and other sound players, stereo equipment and CD radio cassette recorders, audio and video systems for cars, digital media players, headphones, recording media, baby monitors, smartwatches, fitness trackers and other wearable devices, e-book readers, chargers, batteries, cables, power banks, docking stations, computer components and software, excluding games.

SPENDINGCS15_CY.definition: Estimate of garden products and pets expenditures in the geographic area. Consumer Spending data by categories monitor the expenditures of consumers for the various products and services. The target of these data evaluations is the expenditures for the products and services as such, no matter from which sector consumers acquire these products and services. This category includes soil, peat, composts, fertilizers, garden insecticides, pesticides, herbicides and fungicides, lawn turf, plant pots and holders, decorative garden materials, indoor plants and flowers, natural and artificial, outdoor plants and flowers, seeds, bulbs and tubers for planting, shrubs, cut flowers, flower and plant delivery charges. This category also includes pets, pet foods, pet veterinary and grooming products, collars, leashes, kennels, birdcages, fish tanks, cat litter. However, horses, ponies, camels, as well as veterinary and other services for pets and other household animals are excluded from this category.

SPENDINGCS01_CY.definition: Estimate of food and non-alcoholic beverage expenditures in the geographic area. Consumer Spending data by categories monitor the expenditures of consumers for the various products and services. The target of these data evaluations is the expenditures for the products and services as such, no matter from which sector consumers acquire these products and services. This category includes all food and non-alcoholic beverages purchased by households primarily for consumption or preparation at home. It excludes items provided through food and beverage services, such as those offered in restaurants, school cafeterias, or similar establishments. Food refers to all edible products bought and consumed by households for nourishment. This includes: cereals, cereal products, milk, dairy products, eggs, oils, fats, fruits, nuts, vegetables, tubers, plantains, cooking bananas, pulses, sugar, confectionery, desserts, salt, condiments, sauces, spices, culinary herbs, seeds, baby food and ready-to-eat or heat-and-eat prepared meals. Non-alcoholic beverages in this category are those purchased by households, regardless of where they are consumed. However, beverages provided as part of a food service (e.g., in restaurants or cafés) are excluded, as are non-alcoholic versions of typically alcoholic drinks, such as alcohol-free beer or wine.

SPENDINGCS05_CY.definition: Estimate of footwear expenditures in the geographic area. Consumer Spending data by categories monitor the expenditures of consumers for the various products and services. The target of these data evaluations is the expenditures for the products and services as such, no matter from which sector consumers acquire these products and services. This category includes all general footwear for men, women, children and infants and footwear-related services: all footwear for men, women, infants and children, either ready-to-wear or made to measure, including sports footwear suitable for everyday or leisure wear (shoes for jogging, cross-training, tennis, basketball, boating, etc.), gaiters and similar articles, shoelaces, and parts of footwear, such as heels, soles, etc., purchased by households with the intention of undertaking footwear repair themselves. It includes repair of footwear, shoe cleaning services, dyeing of shoes and hire of footwear. It excludes polishes, creams and other shoe-cleaning articles, therapeutic footwear, game-specific footwear (ski boots, football boots, golfing shoes and other such footwear fitted with ice-skates, rollers, spikes, studs, etc.), shin guards, cricket pads and other such protective apparel for sport.

This category includes sofas, couches, tables, chairs, cupboards, chests of drawers and bookshelves, hanger stands, coat stands, bunk beds, baby furniture, highchairs, playpens, beds, mattresses, mattress bases (tatamis), wardrobes, bedside tables, kitchen tables, chairs, cupboards, surfaces, bathroom furniture, outdoor furniture, small garden sheds, camping furniture, ceiling lights, standard lamps, globe lights, bedside lamps, LED strings, loose carpets and rugs, pictures, sculptures, engravings, tapestries, other art objects, other decorative articles, clocks, screens, folding partitions, non-textile blinds, mirrors, candle holders, candlesticks, leather and fur for upholstery, and includes the repair, rental and installation of furniture, furnishings and loose floor coverings.

This category includes motorized tools and equipment such as electric drills, saws, sanders and hedge cutters, garden tractors, lawn mowers, cultivators, and water pumps, hand tools such as saws, hammers, screwdrivers, wrenches, spanners, pliers, trimming knives, rasps and files, garden tools such as wheel barrows, watering cans, hoses, spades, shovels, rakes, forks, scythes, sickles and secateurs, ladders and steps, fittings for radiators and fireplaces, other household accessories (curtain rails, curtain rods, string curtain rods, carpet rods, hooks, etc.) and garden accessories (chains, grids, stakes and hoop segments for fencing and bordering), small electric accessories, such as lamp bulbs, fluorescent lighting tubes, torches, flashlights, hand lamps, electric batteries, chargers and includes the repair and rental charges for such machinery and equipment.

This category includes refrigerators, dual-temperature refrigerators and freezers, dishwashers, electric, gas, oil, ceramic and induction panels, hobs, spit roasters, electric, gas and convection ovens, washing machines, dryers, ironing machines, electric mangles, air conditioners, humidifiers, space heaters, water heaters, ventilators, vacuum cleaners, steam-cleaning and carpet shampooing machines, and other major household appliances such as safes, sewing machines, knitting machines, water softeners, kitchen appliances such as food mixers, blenders, rice cookers, slow cookers, toasters, grills, deep fryers, hot plates, can openers, electric knives, coffee machines, kettles, coffee mills, juice extractors, irons, ironing boards, fans, electric blankets. This category also includes the repair of household appliances.

SPENDINGCS11_CY.definition: Estimate of routine household maintenance expenditures in the geographic area. Consumer Spending data by categories monitor the expenditures of consumers for the various products and services. The target of these data evaluations is the expenditures for the products and services as such, no matter from which sector consumers acquire these products and services. This category includes detergents, hand and machine dishwashing detergents, scouring powders, disinfectant, bleaches, softeners, conditioners and stain removers, general-purpose cleansers, window-cleaning products, unblocking agent, floor waxes, polishes, creams and other shoe-cleaning items, household disinfectants, insecticides, pesticides, fungicides, dustpans, dust brushes, dusters, floor cloths, chamois leathers, dish brushes, household sponges, scourers, steel wool, filters, tablecloths, napkins, kitchen papers, baking parchment rolls, kitchen films, aluminum foils, disposable plates, cups and cutlery, vacuum cleaner bags, garbage bags and other single-use plastic bags, matches, clothes pegs, clothes hangers, pins, safety pins, sewing needles, knitting needles, thimbles, nails, screws, nuts and bolts, tacks, washers, glues, adhesive tapes, string, twine, rubber gloves, gardening gloves, pool cleaning chemicals and water treatment chemicals. This category also includes domestic services provided by paid staff employed by the household, such as butlers, cooks, maids, drivers, gardeners, governesses, au pairs and nannies, window cleaning, disinfection, fumigation and pest extermination, the cleaning, laundering and dyeing of household linen, household textiles and carpets.

SPENDINGCS20_CY.definition: Estimate of jewelry, watches, and personal effects expenditures in the geographic area. This category includes precious stones and metals and jewelry fashioned out of such stones and metals, costume jewelry, cufflinks and tiepins, clocks, watches, stop-watches, alarm clocks, travel clocks, and repair of such articles. Travel goods such as suitcases, trunks, travel bags, attaché cases, satchels, handbags, wallets, purses, etc., articles for babies such as baby carriages, pushchairs, carry cots, recliners, car beds and seats, back-carriers, front carriers and harnesses, etc., articles for smokers such as pipes, lighters, cigarette cases, cigar cutters, etc., miscellaneous personal articles such as sunglasses, walking sticks and canes, umbrellas and parasols, fans, key rings, etc., as well as funerary articles such as coffins, gravestones and urns.

SPENDINGCS12_CY.definition: Estimate of medical products and equipment/appliances expenditures in the geographic area. The target of these data evaluations is the expenditures for the products and services as such, no matter from which sector consumers acquire these products and services. This category includes medicines, vaccines, pharmaceutical preparations, vitamin and mineral supplements, pregnancy testing kits, thermometers, glucose meters, blood pressure meters and other medical devices, inhalers, syringes, humidifiers, nebulizers, hot bags, ice packs, first-aid kits, bandages, assistive and other health-related products used for the prevention, diagnosis and treatment of illnesses, diseases and injuries and purchased by individuals or households, either with or without a prescription, usually from pharmacies, health facilities and medical and assistive equipment suppliers as well as from reliable Internet sources. These products are intended for consumption or use outside a health facility or institution. This category also includes the repair, rental and maintenance of medical and assistive products.

SPENDINGCS19_CY.definition: Estimate of personal care expenditures in the geographic area. Consumer Spending data by categories monitor the expenditures of consumers for the various products and services. The target of these data evaluations is the expenditures for the products and services as such, no matter from which sector consumers acquire these products and services. This category includes electric appliances for personal care such as electric razors, hairdryers, straightening irons, electric toothbrushes, non-electric appliances such as razors, scissors, nail files, combs, hairbrushes, toothbrushes, curlers, scales, personal hygiene products such as soap, shaving cream, deodorants, sunscreens, bath products and toothpaste, beauty products such as lipstick, nail polish, make-up and make-up removal products, shampoo, lotions, and perfumes. This category also includes services provided by hairdressing salons or barbers, as well as facial beauty treatments, tanning salons, pedicure, body care, manicure, saunas, non-medical massages, diet clubs, tattoo and piercing services.

This category includes card games, board games, parlor games, chess sets, video game sofware, hardware, cassettes, downloads and video gaming accessories, toys of all kinds including dolls, soft toys, toy cars and trains, toy bicycles and tricycles, toy construction sets, puzzles, modelling clay, electronic games, remote controlled toy cars, ships, planes and aerial vehicles, stamp-collecting and other collection items, gymnastic, physical education and sporting equipment such as balls,  rackets, bats, skis, golf clubs, body-building equipment, parachutes, paragliders, skydiving equipment, firearms and ammunition for hunting, sport and personal protection, fishing equipment, inflatable boats, rafts and swimming pools, skateboards, hover boards, camping equipment, still cameras, video cameras and accessories, film processing equipment and supplies, binoculars, microscopes, telescopes, camper vans, trailers, boats, yachts, canoes, kayaks, windsurfing boards, diving equipment, hang gliders and hot-air balloons, horses, ponies, and related equipment, golf carts, above ground pools, billiard tables, ping-pong tables, pinball machines, musical instruments, recorded tapes, CD-ROMs, DVDs, Blu-ray discs and downloads of music and films.

SPENDINGCS16_CY.definition: Estimate of recreational and cultural service expenditures in the geographic area. Consumer Spending data by categories monitor the expenditures of consumers for the various products and services. The target of these data evaluations is the expenditures for the products and services as such, no matter from which sector consumers acquire these products and services. This category includes the hire, maintenance and repair of photographic and cinematographic equipment, musical instruments, major recreation durables such as boats, yachts, camper vans, sporting, toys and hobby-related articles.  veterinary and other pet services, such as grooming, tattooing and training, pet boarding and pet day-care services, recreational and sporting services provided at stadiums and other sports venues (swimming pools, golf courses, ski slopes, fairgrounds and amusement parks), playground facilities, gaming arcades, out-of-school lessons and classes, sports club and fitness center membership fees, sports competition participation fees, nightclub entrance fees are included in this category.  Services provided by: cinemas, theatres, opera houses, concert and music venues, circuses, museums, art galleries, exhibitions, libraries, national parks, zoological and botanical gardens, aquariums, as well as services provided by photographers, such as portrait photography, event photography and video production are also included in this category.

SPENDINGCS03_CY.definition: Estimate of tobacco expenditures in the geographic area. Consumer Spending data by categories monitor the expenditures of consumers for the various products and services. The target of these data evaluations is the expenditures for the products and services as such, no matter from which sector consumers acquire these products and services. This category includes all purchases of tobacco and tobacco products by households, including purchases of tobacco in restaurants, cafés, bars and service stations, since those venues do not add value or a service to the tobacco products sold. Refills for electronic cigarettes are included, even though they do not contain tobacco, as they are a substitute for tobacco products. The consumption of tobacco through use of shisha or hookah pipes in restaurants, cafés and bars is excluded as the venues in this case do provide a service.
